title: Figgy Duff
hookLine: Canadian-inspired figgy duff with 10 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Figgy Duff
steps.instructionTemplate: In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, brown sugar, baking powder, and spices. Add raisins and stir well, making sure to coat the raisins in the flour mixture. Incorporate {m53342_1}, {m53342_2}, {m53342_3}, and {m53342_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure all purpose flour first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Figgy Duff
steps.instructionTemplate: Add melted butter, molasses and water and mix with a wooden spoon. Form a ball with the spoon or your hands and put the dough ball in a cotton pudding bag. Tie the bag, leaving at least 1 inch of room to allow the pudding to expand while cooking. Boil pudding for 1.5 hours. (In NL, this is typically done in the pot along with Jiggs Dinner, but it can be done independently.). Incorporate {m53342_5}, {m53342_6}, {m53342_7}, {m53342_8}, {m53342_9}, and {m53342_10} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Figgy Duff
steps.instructionTemplate: When the duff is firm, remove it from the boiling water and let it cool slightly before removing it from the pudding bag. Slice pudding like a cake and serve with the warm sauce of your choice: rum butter sauce, warmed molasses or Molasses Coady sauce (1 cup (250 mL) molasses, 1/4 cup (60 mL) butter, 1/4 cup (60 mL) water) is common in Newfoundland.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

steps.title: Remove from Heat, Cool & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Pull the pan off the heat as soon as Figgy Duff coats the spoon thickly. Let cool slightly so the glaze or custard thickens even more, then spoon into 4 bowls and garnish before serving.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 15 mins!
